response.justification: Significant fundamental misalignment between candidate and role requirements. While the candidate demonstrates strong general software engineering expertise over 20 years, the position explicitly requires deep C++ systems programming (only 6 months in this candidate's career), industrial automation domain knowledge (none demonstrated), and cybersecurity standards expertise (IEC 62443, SDL—not mentioned). Career trajectory is heavily web/JavaScript-focused, lacking embedded systems, real-time, and networking fundamentals essential for this role. Ramp-up time would be extensive.
strengths: 20 years of diverse software development experience demonstrating technical breadth and continuous learning across multiple domains
Strong software craftsmanship practices proven through TDD, CI/CD, agile methodologies, and code quality focus across multiple senior roles
Proven ability to architect scalable, event-driven systems (GISCollective platform) and design high-performance async solutions
concerns: Severely limited C++ experience (6 months at National Instruments vs. role requirement for several years of deep systems programming expertise)
Career centered on web/full-stack JavaScript development with no demonstrated embedded systems, real-time programming, multi-threading, or low-level networking experience
No experience with industrial automation domain, cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443), secure development lifecycle, or industrial protocols (MQTT, Modbus, IEC 61850, OPC UA)
